title: Round a size up safely
prompt: Round bytes up to the next multiple of alignment. alignment must be positive; throw std::invalid_argument for zero. Throw std::overflow_error if the rounded result cannot fit in uint64_t. Alignment need not be a power of two.

tests.label: Already aligned
tests.hint: Do not add a full alignment when the remainder is zero.

tests.label: Non-power-of-two
tests.hint: Bit masks are insufficient for arbitrary alignments.

tests.label: Zero alignment
tests.hint: Reject zero before using the remainder operator.

tests.label: Overflow
tests.hint: Check the available range before adding.

hints: Compare bytes with max - extra before computing bytes + extra.
explanation: Checking before addition avoids unsigned wraparound. This function calculates a size; it does not itself allocate or align a memory address.
